design: two contexts, one vocalization category, the same laughter recordings used in both; only the situation differs

mocking.shared_context: A and B are responsible for bringing sixty pastries to a neighborhood fundraiser at 8 a.m. tomorrow. It is already 8 p.m., and B's oven heats unevenly unless it is watched closely. A has attempted macarons twice before; one batch spread into a single sheet and the other cracked before it could be packed.
mocking.proposal: Let's make sixty macarons from scratch tonight instead of buying cookies.
mocking.why_laughter_reads_this_way: The proposal collides with the short deadline, unreliable oven, and A's established record with this exact difficult pastry, so disbelief is more natural than warm shared amusement; there is no fortunate payoff or longstanding plan being fulfilled.
mocking.expected_inferred_state: A should infer that B takes the proposal as implausibly ambitious rather than as a casual suggestion.
mocking.expected_response_function: insist on seriousness and justify the plan
mocking.gold_response: I'm serious—I borrowed the café's convection oven, and I already weighed everything out.

genuine.relationship: next-door neighbors who share a garden plot
genuine.shared_context: A and B have entered the neighborhood harvest contest for the past two years with pumpkins small enough to carry in one hand. Each time, they painted the pumpkins gold and put a paper ribbon on them that said “Champion.” This week, their shared plot produced a 38-pound pumpkin, and the contest check-in is Saturday morning.
genuine.proposal: Let’s put it in the little red wagon and enter our champion on Saturday.
genuine.why_laughter_reads_this_way: The oversized pumpkin makes their old paper-ribbon joke unexpectedly real, so B’s laughter naturally treats the proposal as a shared payoff and agreement. Derision is less natural because the proposal is practical and the contest is imminent.
genuine.expected_inferred_state: A should infer that B is delighted by the payoff and is on board with entering the pumpkin.
genuine.expected_response_function: move to the practical next step
genuine.gold_response: Great, I’ll bring the wagon around after work.
